newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end up on Ramos' recovery.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end up on Ramos' recovery.

text.p: Manila stocks ended higher on Tuesday as news that President Fidel Ramos was up on his feet a day after undergoing surgery boosted sentiment, brokers said.
The main index ended 12.61 points up at 3,152.53, but was off the day's high of 3,157.65.
"Investors went back to the market after news that the president was recovering well after his operation," said Jonas Ferrer, research director at Pryce Securities.
Another trader at Summit Securities said he expected the market to continue to rise after Christmas on news that Ramos was scheduled to leave the hospital shortly.
The market is closed on Wednesday for Christmas.
Trading was thin, with some 1.7 billion pesos changing hands. All sectors were up except for properties.
